events.input: $ cd /tmp/t299 && cat run-probes.sh; echo ---; cat start.sh; echo ---; for f in *.pid; do p=$(cat $f); echo "$f $p $(ps -p $p -o command= 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-80)"; done; ls -la --time-style=+%H:%M p-*.log r-*.log probes-summary.txt 2>/dev/null || ls -lT p-*.log r-*.log probes-summary.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count conflict hunks per file
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-t299 && for f in app/scripts/probe-day1.mjs app/scripts/probe-day2.mjs app/scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs app/scripts/probe-stack.mjs app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py docs/onboarding-v3/coverage.json; do echo "$f $(grep -c '^<<<<<<<' $f)"; done; head -c 300 docs/onboarding-v3/coverage.json; grep -rn coverage.json app/scripts/*.sh app/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show conflict hunks in code files
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-t299 && for f in app/scripts/probe-day1.mjs app/scripts/probe-day2.mjs app/scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs app/scripts/probe-stack.mjs app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; do echo "=== $f"; awk '/^<<<<<<<|^=======|^>>>>>>>/{print NR": "$0; inside=1} /^<<<<<<</{s=1} s{print substr($0,1,220)} /^>>>>>>>/{s=0}' $f | head -60; done 2>&1 | cut -c1-230 | head -200
